verdict.rationale: WorkOS's MCP docs state that an agent can "read and change the same dashboard data you can" by calling the WorkOS API, and the RBAC docs say roles can be configured in either the Dashboard or the API. A published OpenAPI spec also backs a broad API surface. Missing for 10: an exhaustive first-party statement that every UI action has an API equivalent (the parity claim ends with "and more", and MFA enablement is documented only via the dashboard Authentication page), and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Once connected, your agent can read and change the same dashboard data you can (managing organizations, connections, users, branding, and more) by calling the WorkOS API on your behalf.
Configure roles, permissions, and organization-scoped roles directly in the WorkOS Dashboard or using the API
